subject: maths
question: At a fitness club, 70% of the members are men and 30% of the members are women. If the average age of the men is 30 years and that of the women is 40 years, then what is the average age of all the members?
solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of men = 70%

Percentage of women = 30%

Average age of men = 30 years

Average age of women = 40 years

**Formula Used:**

Weighted Average Age = (Percentage of Men × Average Age of Men + Percentage of Women × Average Age of Women) / 100

**Calculation:**

Weighted Average Age = (70 × 30 + 30 × 40) / 100

Weighted Average Age = (2100 + 1200) / 100

Weighted Average Age = 3300 / 100

⇒ Weighted Average Age = 33 years

**The average age of all the members is 33 years.**
